summary.en: A signed commit lets anyone verify who made a change; an unsigned one in the recent history is reported so signing can be set up.

en: A commit was made without a signature.
I am setting up signing, so each commit says who made it.
fr: Un commit a été fait sans signature.
Je mets en place la signature, pour que chaque commit dise qui l'a fait.

reason.en: A commit in the recent history carries no signature. A signed commit lets anyone verify who made each change, which is why this project signs them. Set up commit signing (a signing key and commit.gpgsign) so new commits are signed. A commit made before signing was set up can be left as it is; new ones should carry a signature.
